Nevertheless ,
it
is
possible
that
such
differences
are
the
result
of
visual
orientation
and

directionality
processing ,
since
the
ganglion
cells
from
the
left
eye

Any

amplitude

These

the
presence
of
at
least
three
different
functional
cell

in

the
ganglion ,

on - center ,
off - center ,
and
on - off

in
which
on - off
response

cell
potentials
are
evoked
by
a
brief
flash
of
light
( Monasterio
et
al .
1975 ) .
Accordingly ,
it

appears
that
the
visual
synaptic
input
to
the
optic
tectum
during
a
looming
response
derives

primarily
from
on-
and
off - response
cells
in
the
ganglion .
